rules: Eyebrows MUST use Arial, be uppercase, and have wide letter spacing (tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-widest).
Story titles and presentation headers in the Client Viewer MUST use Playfair Display.
The Admin/Designer dashboard should use Inter for clarity and density.
Never use default generic sans for large headings.

client_viewer.masthead: Fixed top header with glassmorphism. Contains Brand (INERRE), Project Name, Revision badge, and Navigation Tabs (Ruang / Denah / Layout 3D). z-index: 50.
client_viewer.ruang_stage: The main render view. Use an ambient blur background (a scaled-up, heavily blurred version of the render) behind the main image to create a seamless stage. The main render should be max-h-[80vh] and object-contain.
client_viewer.controls: Topline scene selector for quick jumps. Absolute positioned Prev/Next arrows on the sides.
client_viewer.story_panel: Floating glass panel displaying slide number (e.g., 05/10), title, and description. On Desktop: Bottom-left. On Mobile: Inside a bottom sheet.
client_viewer.thumbnail_rail: Bottom horizontal scrolling list of scene thumbnails. Hide scrollbar. Active thumbnail must feature a 7-second autoplay progress bar.
client_viewer.mini_plan: Floating panel (Bottom-right) on Desktop showing current position dot. On Mobile, replace this with a 'Denah' floating action button.
client_viewer.mobile_adaptations: Hotspot labels must ALWAYS be visible on mobile. Area list must be placed in a bottom sheet.

designer_editor.strategy: High-density dashboard with strict grid hierarchy.
designer_editor.sidebar: Tree view for Project > Floor > Room > Scene.
designer_editor.main_workspace: Central area for Render upload, Hotspot Editor, and Floor Plan Camera Editor.
designer_editor.floor_plan_editor: Interactive canvas where designers can drop camera pins, drag orientation cones, and adjust cone width.
designer_editor.hotspot_editor: Click-to-place absolute dots on the render. Modal/Popover to select target scene, assign labels, and create bidirectional return links.

components.hotspots: Absolute positioned circular indicators. Normal hotspots navigate to scenes. ALT hotspots (Alternative A/B) MUST use the accent color (#c6b38b). Pulse animations applied.
components.camera_pin: SVG icon representing camera position, with an attached semi-transparent cone polygon representing the view angle.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn tabs, customized with the #c6b38b accent color for the active indicator.
components.bottom_sheet: Framer motion powered slide-up panel for mobile views.
components.watermark: INERRE logo placed over the render with low opacity (e.g., opacity-30) prior to approval.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use framer-motion for smooth crossfades between scenes and Ruang/Denah tab switches.
motion_and_interactions.autoplay: 7-second linear fill animation on the active thumbnail's progress bar. Pauses on hover/interaction.
motion_and_interactions.drag_and_drop: Implement drag-and-drop for sorting the tour order and moving camera pins in the editor.
motion_and_interactions.keyboard_nav: Arrow Left/Right for prev/next scene. Escape for exiting fullscreen.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text overlaying renders has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow or a subtle dark gradient overlay behind text panels).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, hotspots, tabs, editor inputs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hotspot-alt-a').

visual_enhancers.borders: Use delicate 1px borders with 10% opacity (border-[#eee9df]/10) to separate panels without visual clutter.
visual_enhancers.ambient_lighting: Crucial for 'Ruang' stage: replicate the render's edge colors in a blurred background layer to make the render feel immersive.

living_room_render.description: Example 3D interior render for the Ruang stage and hotspot editor.

floor_plan.description: Architectural blueprint for the Denah viewer and camera pin editor.

layout_3d.description: Isometric view for the 3D Layout tab.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY .js and .jsx extensions. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Build a Hybrid application containing both the Designer Editor routes and the Client Viewer routes.
Implement the specified color variables precisely: dark background (#171713), surfaces (#20201b), text (#eee9df), and accent (#c6b38b).
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive components for regression testing.
Use Framer Motion for the 7s autoplay bar and scene transitions.
Implement the 'ambient blur' effect on the Ruang stage by placing a heavily blurred (blur-3xl), scaled-up copy of the image absolute-positioned behind the actual render.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use purely transparent backgrounds over content (e.g., sticky headers or dropdowns must have glassmorphism or solid backgrounds).
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable. Use Sonner for toast notifications.
